title.narrative: No Drugs! Food Hub - A sustainable development alternative for youth and communities in Librazhd

description.narrative: At the core of this Action is the model of a Food Hub (produce aggregation businesses that develops new markets for farmers selling into local food wholesale markets) that will be established and turned into a functional center as an alternative to drugs cultivation and trafficking. It will come as a solution for the rural communities to generate income and maximize their profits out of their work in agriculture as the only sources of self-employing.
